ibkr.howTitle: How to get the token and Query ID
ibkr.webOnly: This must be done on the IBKR website (Client Portal), not in the mobile app.
ibkr.step1: Sign in to the IBKR Client Portal in your browser. The official guide points to Performance & Reports → Flex Queries; it also offers Menu → Reporting → Flex Queries. We haven't checked the exact menu names in your language or your account.
ibkr.step2: Create an Activity Flex Query for a single account, with no filters that exclude positions or activity. Use XML. For the daily sync, choose the last available activity day: the statement close must be at most 5 days old, and positions and cash must belong to the same close. This doesn't limit your whole trade history to 5 days.
ibkr.step3: Enable Open Positions, Cash Report, Trades and Cash Transactions. To complete the history and cross-check the calculations, add Currency Conversion Rate, Transfers and Corporate Actions. Select every field available in those sections, including Account ID, Currency, Report Date, trade IDs, quantities, prices, costs and commissions. Not every account offers the same fields.
ibkr.step4: Optionally, add Statement of Funds, Forex Balances, Change in Dividend Accruals and Open Dividend Accruals. They're for cross-checking: including them doesn't mean they all feed GerarAI's calculations yet. In Open Positions, keep the Summary level for each position's total; lots are extra detail, not a replacement for that total. We haven't checked the exact format and level options your screen offers.
ibkr.step5: Save the query. In Flex Queries, open the info icon next to it and copy the Query ID shown at the top. It's the query's ID, not your account number.
ibkr.step6: In Flex Queries → Flex Web Service Configuration, open the settings gear and turn the service on. Copy the token and check when it expires. Generating a new one invalidates the old one. If you restrict the token by IP, it must allow the GerarAI server's IP, not just your phone's or computer's.
ibkr.step7: Come back to this form and enter the token, Query ID and the exact IBKR account in the statement. Don't share the token in chat. When you press Connect and import we'll check the report and, if it's valid, import the data. IBKR can take a while to prepare it. Leave the full-query option unticked until you've confirmed it covers the whole account: that option allows closing positions and removing missing balances.
ibkr.flexNote: Flex provides statements, not real-time data. A recent trade may not show up until IBKR prepares the next report. A complete tax history may need an extra historical import; the latest close on its own doesn't guarantee every trade is there.
ibkr.guideQuery: Official guide: query and Query ID
ibkr.guideToken: Official guide: enable the service and get the token
ibkr.tokenNote: The token expires according to the period chosen in IBKR. It's stored encrypted and never shown again. We don't need your IBKR password.
ibkr.completeQuery: I confirm the query covers this whole account, with no filters. I allow closing positions and removing imported IBKR balances that no longer appear. If unticked, data is only added or updated.
ibkr.disconnectWarning: The saved token will be deleted and future syncs will stop. Your positions and transactions are kept. To revoke the token in IBKR, also do it on their website.

currency.title: Base currency
currency.description: The currency your portfolio and its totals are shown in. Tax reporting stays in euros.
currency.label: Base currency
currency.howBody: The portfolio and its totals are shown in this currency, and gain/loss is split into price effect and currency effect. Each holding is still shown in the currency it trades in. Transactions are stored in their original currency and converted when read, so changing the base rewrites nothing. IRPF (Spanish income tax) and Modelo 720 are always in EUR at the ECB rate.

dca.title: DCA alerts
dca.legacyOne: You have 1 old per-company setting: it is kept but no longer applied.
dca.legacyMany: You have {count} old per-company settings: they are kept but no longer applied.
dca.savedLegacy: DCA alerts saved for all your companies. Old per-company settings are kept with no effect.
dca.saved: DCA alerts saved for all your companies.
dca.intro: One setting for your whole watchlist and portfolio. It doesn't change the verdict or place orders.
dca.defaults: Defaults: 3X when rising and 1X when falling.
dca.serverOff: Alert sending is turned off on the server. Saving these thresholds doesn't turn it on.
dca.rule: The new level is what counts: with 3X rising and 1X falling, it alerts on 2X → 3X and 2X → 1X. It doesn't alert on 1X → 2X or 3X → 2X. It also alerts on 3X → 4X, but not on 4X → 3X. No alert on the first evaluation or if the level doesn't change.
dca.trims: Trims have their own control on the server and aren't changed here.
